newsitem.title: USA: NCR Corp up in when-issued trading.
newsitem.headline: NCR Corp up in when-issued trading.

text.p: NCR Corp shares were up 3-7/8 to 40-1/8 in when-issued trading on the New York Stock Exchange at midday Thursday.
An NCR spokesman said the stock would begin trading independently from parent AT&T Corp on January 2.
Wednesday, the first day the stock's value was recorded, it rose to 36-1/4 from 30-7/8, spokesman Jim Mazzola said in a telephone interview.
Mazzola said the when-issued activity meant large investors were establishing a value for the stock.
"Our chief executive officer, Lars Nyberg, has been on a road show talking with major investors to position the company in the market. We've gotten some visibility because of that," Mazzola said.
Nyberg said in October that NCR had moved into the black in the first nine months of 1996. It lost $722 million on sales of $8.1 billion in 1995.
Dayton-based NCR, formerly National Cash Register, makes computer systems and automated teller machines.
